name: Allison Donovan
biography: Allison Donovan is a security researcher who specializes in cloud-based platforms and services. She was previously employed as a Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer at Cruise, where she secured cloud-based environments at scale, and previously worked at Microsoft on mobile application security and site reliability engineering.
